limitations: Only the local Windows/GPU configuration was tested.
Agent-created covered tabs run at full rate for 15 seconds after creation, so they can still compete with the selected tab during that window under a driver frame limit.
Frame pacing requires Xenon's engine build; published stock-engine releases ignore it.
No physical speaker output, DRM, network adaptation, picture-in-picture or real website acceptance.
